name: Fey Hobgoblin Variant
body:
Far fewer hobgoblins were lured by the temptations of the fey than their goblin kin—yet it is undeniable that some hobgoblins display the gifts of the fey. They have overdeveloped canines, long, lupine ears, flowing black hair, and blood red skin that cools to blue when they are at peace—which is never. Unlike their goblin cousins, most fey hobgoblins embrace their eternal servitude to the Fey King and Queen, finding purpose in the terms of their contract and exploiting their newfound gifts to their advantage.

Fey Heritage Your type is fey instead of humanoid; you retain the goblinoid subtype. You gain low-light vision, and your ability score adjustments are +2 Dex, +2 Int. This trait alters your type and ability scores, and replaces darkvision.

Alternate Species Traits
Bugblooded Your ancestry is not entirely hobgoblin but is at least partially bugbear, as evident by your excessive hairiness and hulking build. You gain +2 Str, +2 Dex. This trait alters ability scores.
Team Tactics Traits You draw inspiration from your allies in battle. As long as you can see, hear, or otherwise sense at least one ally, you can use the following ability a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1): if you or an ally you perceive fails an ability check, skill check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can use an immediate action to add +1d6 to the result. This can cause a failed roll to become a success. If the roll was a natural 1, it is no longer treated as such; however, a roll that was not a natural 20 cannot become a natural 20 using this ability. This trait replaces sneaky.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
